title: AmEx Rewards Points
body:
Hi Brainstrust
I have about 300k Amex rewards points accrued over a year (bonus, spend, etc). I plan to close the Business Platinum card due to its high fees and low utility for me, by the end of this month. Just seeking options on how to best use the points. Preference is to book travel and happy to be made aware of best conversions and tricks. I do have reasonable balance in both qantas (400k) and velocity frequent flyer account( 700K).
Thanks
